title: Large-Bank Deposit Insurance Determination Modernization (91 FR 69642, 2026-22495)
key_claim: The FDIC proposes to rescind 12 CFR part 370. Of 4,287 insured institutions, 148 would be affected, including 31 part 370 institutions, 29 of them becoming larger covered institutions under revised section 360.9. The five Highest Complexity institutions hold about $6.8 trillion in domestic deposits. Industry savings are about $33 million a year, offset by $14 million of first-year costs; comments are due by January 4, 2027.
